releaseNotes:
• Startup Missing Permissions Popup: Automatically prompts on launch for any ungranted permissions with one-tap Grant All Access.
• Direct App Info Button for Restricted Settings: Added Step 1: Open App Info (Allow Restricted Settings) directly on the Usage Access card in User Policy & Android Access.
• Crash & Stability Fixes: Safe camera permission check before scanning and OEM-safe settings intents.
